thread:
Lena (partnerships): Hey team, ACME's marketplace PO shows as ACK in their portal but our AP ingestion is rejecting it. Partner says they've already accepted; finance is blocking payout. Need a quick triage.

Omar - Deal Desk: Which PO ID?

Lena (partnerships): PO 2024-ACM-7723. Here's the XML fragment they pushed (sanitized):
```xml
<PurchaseOrder id=\"2024-ACM-7723\">
  <VendorBillingEntity>ACME-CORP-UK</VendorBillingEntity>
  <MarketplaceBillingEntity>Redwood-EMEA</MarketplaceBillingEntity>
  <TaxId>GB999999999</TaxId>
</PurchaseOrder>
```

Priya (legal): The contract we have on file requires the billing entity to match the signed MSA alias. Do we have an MSA alias for ACME-CORP-UK? If not, redlines on entity will cause invoice rejection. I can't rubber-stamp retro changes.

Jordan (finance): AP log shows failure: "billing_entity_mismatch" and "taxid_mismatch". Their portal marked ACK at 2024-07-15T05:20:42Z, our webhook box processed a delivery at 05:21:03 and tried mapping to Redwood-EMEA which fails because vendor alias differs.

Ravi (partner ops): Sounds like an ACK timing race — portal ACK + partner rep did a manual update after ACK. Marketplace webhook returned 502 for one delivery (see bot). We might have processed a partial payload.

marketplace-bot: delivery_status: failed, code: 502, url: /webhooks/marketplace/ack, attempt: 2

Omar - Deal Desk: If partner can re-submit with the alias that matches MSA (Redwood-EMEA) that will fix mapping. Can we do a temporary manual mapping to accept current invoices while they fix the portal?

Priya (legal): I won't sign off on retroactive aliasing. I can prepare a limited waiver template the customer can sign (one-off) acknowledging the alias difference and tax implications. We need a signed doc before revenue recognition.

Jordan (finance): We can create a GL suspense bucket for this invoice and release payment once waiver + corrected PO are in. I'll need PO number, invoice, and waiver reference.

Lena (partnerships): Partner is willing to sign waiver by EOD if we give them a safe path to get the invoice processed. They prefer we don't cancel the ACK since their procurement system marks things final.

Ravi (partner ops): I'll open a marketplace support ticket requesting a re-delivery/ack correction and include webhook logs. If the marketplace can re-emit the ACK with the MSA alias, ingestion will succeed.

Omar - Deal Desk: Quick checklist: 1) Can legal draft waiver? 2) Can finance accept invoice into suspense? 3) Will partner re-emit ACK?

Priya (legal): I will draft a limited waiver & send to Lena for partner signature. Template will include: scope (single PO), no change to MSA terms, acknowledgement of billing entity mismatch.

Jordan (finance): I will create suspend code SUSP-EMEA-01 and hold funds. Need ledger owner to sign off. I can provisionally accept invoice into suspense once waiver ID is posted.

Ravi (partner ops): Ticket opened: PR-20245 with marketplace support. Link: https://marketplace.support/tickets/PR-20245 (internal). I attached webhook logs and the failed payload.

Omar - Deal Desk: If marketplace can't re-emit, partner will need to cancel and reissue PO from their procurement with Redwood-EMEA alias. That may slip close-of-month. Let's try the waiver path first.

Lena (partnerships): Action items: @Ravi open support ticket (done: PR-20245), @Priya draft waiver, @Jordan create suspense GL and hold, @Omar confirm partner will re-emit or cancel/resubmit. I'll coordinate partner signature. :thumbsup:

Jordan (finance): I'll create the suspense entry and notify revenue ops. Report ID: FIN-SUSP-7432.

Priya (legal): Draft in progress, will send to Lena for partner e-sign today.

Ravi (partner ops): Noted. I'll follow up with marketplace and ping once re-delivery ETA is known.

Lena (partnerships): Thanks all — let's sync if anything changes. Closing thread when waiver signed and either re-ACK or resubmitted PO is in the queue. :v:
notes: escalation: vendor alias vs MSA billing entity; temporary legal waiver + finance suspense approved; marketplace webhook delivery failure implicated timing race
